clue.text: With this trouble you need a doctor before becoming able to move

definitions.text: With this trouble you need a doctor before becoming able to move

parts.words: With this trouble you need a doctor before becoming able to move
parts.note: trouble here is ill humour or bitterness; put MO, a doctor, in front of the word and it becomes a word meaning able to move

explanation.surface: A patient is told that only a doctor's visit will get them back on their feet.
explanation.walkthrough: MO is a medical officer, a doctor; placed before the answer it makes MOBILE, able to move. The answer itself is the trouble: bile is bitterness or bad temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitterness and irritability were once thought to come from an excess of this bodily fluid, so it stands for trouble of temper.

clue.text: Writers inside wrongly get hand out

indicators.note: the first part of the word inside acts as a container signal, putting the writers within
wrongly means these letters are set out in the wrong order

parts.note: taken as written, the second half of inside
pens are writing instruments

explanation.surface: Writers are getting something wrong while working indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: The trick is to split 'inside' into two words: its first half is the container signal and its second half is the fodder that 'wrongly' scrambles.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispense is to distribute or deal out, a straight synonym of hand out.

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the word upside down, so it is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Reno in Nevada is famous for its casinos

explanation.surface: A gambling den takes a heavy hit and is turned over.
explanation.definitionFit: A oner is British slang for a single mighty punch, one blow that does the job.

indicators.note: in a down clue, dropped means the letter is moved lower within the word

parts.note: taken as written
an L-plate is the learner sign on a British car, so plate gives L

explanation.surface: A dinner plate falls into the washing-up water.
explanation.walkthrough: In ABLUTION, the L moves down two places to give ABUTILON.
explanation.definitionFit: Abutilon is a genus of flowering shrubs in the mallow family, sometimes called flowering maple.

parts.note: bird is British slang for a jail sentence, so a cage for bird is where such time is served

explanation.surface: Just a cage for a pet bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing bird means serving time, and the cage where it is done is a jail.

clue.text: Did Halliwell perform nothing on an instrument?

parts.note: taken as written
Geri Halliwell, Ginger Spice of the Spice Girls
to do is to perform
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A pop star is asked whether she ever played some instrument with no effort at all.
explanation.definitionFit: The didgeridoo is a long wooden wind instrument of Aboriginal Australia.

clue.text: Steer ran over a Mrs Alexander

indicators.note: the steer goes over part of ran, set within it

parts.note: taken as written
a steer is a young castrated ox
taken as written

explanation.surface: A steer runs over a woman called Mrs Alexander.
explanation.definitionFit: Roxana was the Bactrian princess who married Alexander the Great, so she was his wife.

definitions.meaning: advanced money is money loaned out
the Christian season of fasting before Easter

explanation.definitionFit: Lent is the past tense of lend (advanced as a loan) and the forty-day Christian fast.

clue.text: View to drop work at the back of the 18

indicators.note: to drop means these letters are taken out of the word

parts.note: a view is an opinion
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a point of view about the back of a nut.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 is NUT, here meaning head; the inion is a bony point at the back of the skull.
explanation.definitionFit: The inion is the projecting point of the occipital bone at the back of the skull.

clue.text: Doll swallows a large quantity of 26

indicators.note: swallows means the doll takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: Barbie is the famous fashion doll
a ton, informally, is a lot

explanation.surface: A doll gulps down a great deal of drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Barbitone is a barbiturate sedative, a drug that dopes those who take it.

indicators.note: boiling suggests churning, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Superheated water is boiling away somewhere in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The Euphrates is a great river flowing through Turkey, Syria and Iraq.

definitions.meaning: Ulysses S ..., Union general in the American Civil War

explanation.definitionFit: Grant was a famous US general, and in law a grant is a conveyance of property by deed.

clue.text: Tangle one, perhaps, gets into from such activity

indicators.note: the letter enters the scrambled word
perhaps hints that the letters may be arranged otherwise

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A tangle someone gets into as a result of certain activity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' shuffles TANGLE to GENTAL, and 'gets into' puts I inside: GENITAL. The definition refers coyly to sexual activity.
explanation.definitionFit: Genital means relating to reproduction, describing what arises from sexual activity.

definitions.meaning: Sir George ... compiled the famous Dictionary of Music and Musicians

explanation.definitionFit: A grove is a small wood, and Grove's Dictionary of Music made Sir George Grove a musical name.

clue.text: … great music composed by one of 28

indicators.note: composed suggests the letters being put together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Great music, composed by a classical goddess.
explanation.walkthrough: 28 is NINE: the nine Muses of Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: Melpomene, the muse of tragedy, is one of the nine Muses.

clue.text: Direction providing no way without conflict

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the way surrounds the conflict

parts.note: RD is short for road, a way
war is conflict

explanation.surface: Peace is possible only if there is no route out of fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: Norward is an old form of northward, a compass direction.

indicators.note: unmade roads are rough, so the letters are put back together differently

explanation.surface: Travel along rough, unsurfaced roads.
explanation.definitionFit: Dorsa is the plural of the anatomical dorsum, meaning the back.

clue.text: Letter conveying resistance to current pressures

definitions.text: Letter conveying resistance to current pressures

parts.words: Letter conveying resistance to current pressures
parts.note: a Greek letter used as the symbol of the ohm, the unit of electrical resistance, opposing current

explanation.surface: A protest letter resists the pressures of the moment.
explanation.definitionFit: The last Greek letter, written as a capital, is the symbol for the ohm in electrical units.

definitions.meaning: the National Union of Teachers, a British teachers' union

explanation.definitionFit: Nut is slang for the head, and NUT is the British National Union of Teachers.

indicators.note: different means the letters are made to take a new order

parts.note: the answer to 8 down, the fast before Easter
taken as written

explanation.surface: Fasting can mean something different to a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Georg Philipp Telemann was a prolific German Baroque composer.

indicators.note: sliced means cut up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: No sliced bread allowed.
explanation.definitionFit: To debar is to exclude or prohibit, a synonym of rule out.

definitions.meaning: a make of pistol and machine gun

explanation.definitionFit: Browning is the name of a Victorian poet and of a well-known make of firearm.

clue.text: Pals die wrestling with poisonous snakes

indicators.note: wrestling twists things about, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Friends die fighting deadly snakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Elapids are the venomous snake family that includes cobras, mambas and coral snakes.

clue.text: Primate took up 13 across activity — it's the tops!

parts.note: an ape is a primate

indicators.note: in a down clue, took up means the word is read upwards

parts.note: the activity of 13 across, genital, is sex

explanation.surface: A monkey took up sex and called it the best thing ever.
explanation.definitionFit: Apexes are peaks or summits, the topmost points of things.

parts.note: a rood is an old unit of land area, a quarter of an acre

explanation.surface: A street district in Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'in Kent': the answer is a place there.
explanation.definitionFit: Strood is a town on the River Medway in the English county of Kent.

clue.text: Overtures made by boy to girl?

definitions.text: Overtures made by boy to girl?

parts.words: Overtures made by boy to girl?
parts.note: romantic advances suggested, but really Beethoven's overtures for Fidelio, whose heroine disguises herself as the boy Fidelio

explanation.surface: A young man makes advances to a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Beethoven wrote three overtures named after his heroine, who disguises herself as a young man in Fidelio.

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, the count of reams
a ream is 500 sheets of paper, so 500 reams make 250,000

explanation.surface: Picture a huge pile of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: To dream is to imagine or fancy something.

parts.note: to do is to perform
PE is physical education, school sport

explanation.surface: Someone mocks another for doing gym exercises.
explanation.definitionFit: A dope is a stupid person, an idiot or fool.

parts.note: rum is a spirit
taken as written
worker ants

explanation.surface: Cattle with drink in labourers.
explanation.definitionFit: Cows chew the cud, which makes them members of the cud-chewing group of mammals.

clue.text: Some men in back of Morris?

definitions.text: Some men in back of Morris?

parts.words: Some men in back of Morris?
parts.note: the old board game is called ... men's morris, so this number of men stands behind the word Morris

explanation.surface: Passengers are crammed into the back seat of a Morris car.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine men's morris is an old board game, so this number counts the men before Morris.

clue.text: Detail of undressed kid taken to court

indicators.note: de-tail, take away the tail, so the last letter goes

parts.note: suede is kid leather with an unfinished napped surface

explanation.surface: A naked child is taken to court in detail.
explanation.definitionFit: To be sued is to be the subject of a lawsuit, taken to court.

clue.text: Put pressure on journalists to drink

parts.note: the press is journalists collectively
to down a drink is to swallow it

explanation.surface: Journalists are pressed to have a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To press down is to push or bear down on something.

definitions.meaning: as in for the time being, this one occasion
..., not Church of England, the stance of Dissenters

explanation.definitionFit: The word means the present occasion, as in for the nonce; split, it reads not Church of England.
